```
['run TTS inference to generate a WAV audio file from input text using a model checkpoint', 'review the TextMapper class that converts text to symbol ID sequences for TTS models', 'test the TextMapper text_to_sequence method that converts text strings to integer symbol ID lists', 'refactor the TextMapper uromanize method to romanize non-Latin script text using a Perl uroman script', 'summarize the TextMapper filter_oov method that removes out-of-vocabulary characters from input text']
```
